result.reason: The added language substantively reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data export within 30 days, and deletion certification. However, it overreaches by requiring return and deletion of all Customer data upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment, even when other attachments remain active. That could disrupt continuing services and conflicts with the original clause’s treatment of partial termination. The provision should apply only to data associated with the terminated attachment, or to all data only upon termination of the entire Agreement. The 30-day period also runs from Customer’s request rather than directly from expiry or termination.
